chapter_name: My Dance Expresses Emotions and Narrates Stories
learning_objective: 🎯 Let's discover how dancers use their faces and hands to tell magical tales without saying a single word!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: In Indian classical dance, dancers use special hand signs called Mudras. They can make their hands look like a blooming lotus, a flying bird, or a swimming fish!
A dancer's face can show anger, joy, fear, or surprise. They stretch their eyes wide, move their eyebrows, and smile broadly to share these strong feelings with the audience.
By putting together hand gestures, strong facial expressions, and powerful body poses, a dancer can act out an entire epic story like a silent movie.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Emoji Face Drawing!
fun_activity.instructions: Look in the mirror and make the happiest face, then the angriest face, then the most surprised face! Draw all three expressions focusing on how your eyebrows and mouth change.

quick_recap: ⭐ Mudras are magical hand gestures that represent animals, nature, and objects.
⭐ Dancers change their facial expressions to show exactly what they are feeling.
⭐ Dance is a beautiful way to tell stories without using any words at all.
